acceptance.criterion: A retained pre-fix control demonstrates the redirected cached-shell defect; fixed-worker controls supply navigation-compatible shell responses without losing body, required headers or asset integrity.
Fresh and existing-cache browser controls load allowlisted app routes online and after offline preparation, preserve non-shell routing boundaries and avoid an update/reload loop.

A worker-only update recovers an already redirected cached shell while synthetic durable-data and subscription canaries remain unchanged. Failed repair/install cannot activate a partial new build or destroy the working prior cache.

Published frontend packaging and relevant synthetic/browser checks pass with exact source/artifact identities, named engine versions and explicit limitations. Required browser evidence unavailable in the execution environment prevents local acceptance until the missing check is supplied.

Report local repair acceptance separately from production publication and affected-iPhone validation. Retain both original screenshots and the missing device/build observations; local acceptance does not close the physical incident.

limitations: No production publication, affected-iPhone controller observation or physical Safari/standalone qualification.
The browser fixture runs the actual emitted worker with a synthetic integrity manifest and shell; full Blazor startup is not established by the fixture.
Private/ephemeral WebKit storage behavior is not qualified by the passing persistent-profile controls.
Synthetic subscription marker only; no actual push subscription, permission, inspection or delivery.
Release publication retains the existing optional wasm-tools optimization warning.
The initial shared-build-server publish timed out; serial builds pass.
outcome: The Release worker safely reconstructs validated public shell responses and separates repaired caches; local Chromium and WebKit controls reproduce the old defect and pass update, offline, integrity-failure and data-preservation checks.
title: Correct redirect-bearing PWA shell responses and recover existing caches
